RECOMMENDATION: RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 30

That number is a low-confidence subjective estimate, not a statistically grounded probability.

An all-male panel warrants a question about selection procedures; it does not establish bias. Your leadership qualifications and experience also justify asking how candidates were assessed, although the announcement may omit relevant qualifications or interview evidence.

Follow up now on your written-explanation request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment against them, and whether panel composition complied with applicable rules. Frame this as a request for transparency, not an accusation.

Keep correspondence and check complaint deadlines promptly. Which country was this in? Panel-composition requirements, response deadlines and remedies depend on jurisdiction.
